official.deadline_note: Pre-registration is open from 8:00 a.m. on 5 August 2026 until 5:00 p.m. on 20 October 2026 (extended deadline per the II-2026 bases).
official.status_note: The official instructions page shows Convocatoria II-2026 as open; the II-2026 bases set pre-registration from 8:00 a.m. 5 August 2026 to 5:00 p.m. 20 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The official FAQ states the fund does not support paying for undergraduate or master's studies: 'El Fondo Colombia Biodiversa no da apoyo para pagar estudios superiores, pero sí brinda una ayuda económica para la elaboración de tesis de pregrado o maestría.'
benefits: Maximum grant of three million five hundred thousand Colombian pesos (COP 3'500.000) per scholarship
Funds may be used to purchase equipment needed for the research; ownership of the equipment stays with the scholar

One II-2026 grantee working on and in the Colombian Orinoquía can use the AKAE Conservación Reserve and its facilities for field research, plus land and sea transfer, lodging and food inside the reserve under the convention
eligibility: Colombian students (the call is open only to Colombian students)
Enrolled in an undergraduate or master's programme at an ICFES-approved national university or a formally recognised foreign university
Degree project must be a thesis proposal approved by the faculty and not exceed 50% execution at the close of the call
Individual or collective modality; collective proposals must have members from the same programme and a designated coordinator
requirements: Read the bases of the II-2026 call before applying
Complete the three-stage online pre-registration form
Keep the research proposal to a maximum of five pages in the prescribed format
Have the thesis approved by the faculty and submit the director's letter and the faculty letter
State whether any artificial-intelligence tool was used in the proposal and at which stage
Mention any framework collection permits needed for sampling wild species
Submit the total project budget, identifying which lines the grant will cover
documents: Research proposal of no more than five pages (Times New Roman 12, 1.5 cm margins) with title, introduction, general and specific objectives, relevance to biodiversity, methodology, expected results and bibliography
Detailed and justified budget identifying which lines the Becas Colombia Biodiversa grant will cover; the amount requested may not exceed COP 3'500.000
Activity timetable with start/end months and current state of progress
Letter from the thesis supervisor to the Colombia Biodiversa Fund certifying the thesis is approved (for collective proposals, naming every member)
Letter from the faculty on letterhead to the Colombia Biodiversa Fund certifying the thesis is approved
Official enrolment certificate issued by the university
Recommendation letter from a faculty professor other than the thesis director
selection_criteria: The proposal must be a research thesis proposal on the knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity
Students from all areas of knowledge may apply as long as the degree project turns on Colombian biodiversity
Approved thesis at the start of execution or not yet started - finished or advanced projects cannot apply
coverage: Research costs for the approved thesis, up to COP 3'500.000
Equipment needed for the research, purchased with the grant, ownership stays with the scholar
The fund does not cover tuition and does not pay for health-risk insurance during field work
application_method: Stage 1: type of proposal (individual or collective), personal, work, publication and recommendation data
Stage 2: category (undergraduate or master's), abstract, motivation and funding sources
Stage 3: file uploads and a short survey
FAAE verifies the form and documents and emails the definitive registration number
official.application_route: Complete the three-stage online pre-registration form on the Colombia Biodiversa page; FAAE then verifies it and issues the definitive registration number by email.
official.citizenship_residency: Colombian students only; Colombians studying abroad may apply if the project relates directly to Colombian biodiversity
official.international_eligibility: Colombian students enrolled abroad at a formally recognised foreign university may apply if the project relates directly to Colombian biodiversity
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Degree thesis on the knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity, from any area of knowledge; only research proposals qualify
official.research_requirement: The proposal must be a research thesis proposal approved by the faculty, at the start of execution or not yet started
official.duration: Undergraduates have a maximum of one year and master's students two years from the award to complete the research
official.description: The Fundación Alejandro Ángel Escobar's Colombia Biodiversa Fund supports undergraduate and master's students with research grants for degree theses on the knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity, across all areas of knowledge.

verification.notes: The official FAAE instructions page and the II-2026 bases PDF (extended deadline version) were read in full: maximum grant COP 3'500.000 per scholarship, pre-registration 8:00 a.m. 5 August to 5:00 p.m. 20 October 2026, the exact document list, the one/two-year completion windows, the tuition exclusion, the equipment-ownership rule, the insurance disclaimer and the AKAE Conservación reserve convention are all published there.

applicant_utility.summary: This grant pays for your thesis research, not your degree: the fund says outright it will not pay tuition, so treat the COP 3.5 million ceiling as your research budget, with the total project budget allowed to exceed it if other sources cover the rest. The file is document-heavy - supervisor letter, faculty letter on letterhead, enrolment certificate, recommendation letter from a professor who is not your director - so start collecting signatures weeks before 20 October 2026. If your fieldwork is in the Orinoquía, the AKAE Conservación reserve convention can also open a field station to one II-2026 grantee.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Colombian undergraduate or master's students with a faculty-approved biodiversity thesis at the start of execution, especially field or sampling work in the Orinoquía.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your thesis is faculty-approved and under 50% executed at the close of the call
Get the supervisor letter and the faculty letter on letterhead early - both must name every member of a collective proposal
Build the five-page proposal exactly to format: Times New Roman 12, 1.5 cm margins, with all required sections
Prepare the justified budget showing which lines the grant covers and which come from other sources
Secure the recommendation letter from a professor other than your thesis director
Declare any AI tool use in the proposal and any wild-species collection permits needed
common_rejection_risks: A proposal that is already finished or in an advanced execution stage
Requesting more than COP 3'500.000 from the fund
Missing either the supervisor letter or the faculty letter - both are mandatory and must address the Colombia Biodiversa Fund
Applying with a project that is not a degree thesis, or not a research proposal
Leaving the enrolment certificate or identity document out of the uploads
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition and study fees, health-risk insurance for field or laboratory work (the fund disclaims responsibility), and any budget line beyond the COP 3'500,000 grant.
document_audit: Collective proposals need every member's enrolment certificate and identity documents unified into single files
The recommendation letter must not come from the thesis director
AI-use and collection-permit declarations are explicit checkboxes in the form - do not leave them blank
alerts: The II-2026 pre-registration closes at 5:00 p.m. on 20 October 2026 (extended)
FAAE, not the student, activates the definitive registration after verifying the form and uploads - check inbox and spam for the number

Winners commit to progress reports, the approved thesis, a manuscript submitted for publication, a web abstract and FAAE seminars, signed by contract and a pagaré with a co-signer; failure means returning the full grant
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fill the three-stage online pre-registration (data, category/abstract/motivation, uploads/survey); FAAE verifies and emails the definitive registration number; awarded students then work within their one-year (undergraduate) or two-year (master's) window.
